t: Evolution R210CMS 210mm electric single-bevel compound mitre saw is a versatile tool suitable for cutting multiple materials in various construction and DIY tasks. Designed with a powerful 1200W high torque motor and robust 20-tooth TCT blade to effortlessly cut steel, aluminium, wood, nail-embedded timber, and plastic using a single blade. The compact, lightweight 5.8kg design and ergonomic handle ensure easy transport across sites or workshops. Features a maximum cross cut capacity of 125 x 55mm and a no-load speed of 3750rpm to deliver efficient, accurate results. Ideal for tradesmen installing skirting boards, decking, or general fabrication work. Includes workpiece clamp and dust extraction facility for enhanced user experience. Dust bag not supplied.
